request_order: Exact DF016 proposal calls array, parameters, TR, earliest-not-before and following quote dependency; no replacement or reordering
authorization: Fresh exact human statement and scope plus independent service/rate/rights/calendar/security/clock review. Files/hashes or verified booleans alone cannot register trusted approval. Empty reviewed digest registry in this version; later registration needs explicit trusted review.
tls: Fixed HTTPS host/port, default trusted CA and hostname verification, TLS >=1.2; handshake and deadline recheck before secret HTTP transmission. No redirects, custom hosts, proxy or LIVE fallback.
storage: Immutable hash-chained pre-I/O reservations, per-attempt outcomes/raw hashes/normalized lineage, conservative peak storage reservations, single-process lock and integrity audit. Auth/sensitive bodies hash-only, tokens memory-only. Restart never refunds or reissues consumed auth.
failure_policy: HTTP and transport failures consume attempts. Auth failure stops. Price retry once only for transient 429/5xx/IO within same item, stricter provider cooldown/Retry-After and hard deadline. Interrupted reservation remains spent and unresolved; no automatic network resume without in-memory token.
research: SOURCE/SCHEMA/TEMPORAL/MARKET/CORRECTION/ORB5/ORB15/POST_SIGNAL_QUOTE independent. Unknown bar semantics/first trade/market/correction remain HOLD. No profit or fill verification, RVOL_NOT_READY.
retention: Manual dry-run plan and explicit expiry purge for exact new pilot store only; never modify prior data. No automatic deletion job. Hash audit retention requires separate rights confirmation.
